en.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina: up to 31 cm of new snow on the way, most of it on Thursday 26 November
en.description: Bosnia and Herzegovina: up to 31 cm of new snow on the way, most of it on Thursday 26 November
en.lede: The week ahead could bring up to 31 cm to the snowiest slopes in Bosnia and Herzegovina, 2 cm of it in the next three days. The biggest day looks like Thursday 26 November, with up to 27 cm.

p: Forecasts this far out move. The timing is usually more reliable than the totals, so keep a flexible plan and check again two days before you go.
Snow covers roughly 0 km² in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 19 November, little changed from yesterday.
Expect up to 2 cm on the snowiest slopes by the third day; the seven-day total reaches 31 cm.
Thursday 26 November stands out, with up to 27 cm in a day.
Further out, days 8 to 14 show up to 13 cm on the snowiest slopes.
The 12 resorts in Bosnia and Herzegovina on our map are still green.
The last three days were dry or nearly so, with no more than 0 cm anywhere.
Snow cover in Bosnia and Herzegovina over the last days: 16 November 490 km²; 17 November 1,060 km²; 18 November 0 km²; 19 November 0 km².
The deepest resort changed hands 2 times this week.

sections.h: How much of the country is white
p: No height band is mostly white yet. Over the week the white area has hardly moved from 0 km².

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Croatia: 0 % white, deepest Platak with 0 cm, up to 29 cm in the week ahead; Serbia: 0 % white, deepest Kopaonik with 0 cm, up to 7 cm in the week ahead.

sections.h: What it means on the slopes
p: A quiet spell: groomed runs stay reliable, the snow off the pistes gets older and firmer.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.

advice: Read the local avalanche bulletin before going off-piste.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.
Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.

bs.title: Snijeg u Bosni i Hercegovini danas: visina snježnog pokrivača i novi snijeg, 19. novembra 2026.
bs.description: Snijeg u Bosni i Hercegovini 19. novembra: snježni pokrivač, novi snijeg, visina po nadmorskoj visini, naredni dani i najbolji ski-centri.
bs.lede: Snježni pokrivač u Bosni i Hercegovini zauzima oko 0 km² (četvrtak, 19. novembra). Površina je gotovo ista kao jučer.

p: Nijedan visinski pojas još nije pretežno bijel. Za sedam dana površina se gotovo nije promijenila u odnosu na 0 km².
Posljednja tri dana gotovo nije padao snijeg: maksimum je 0 cm.
Malo promjena: uređene staze su pouzdane, a snijeg izvan njih stari i stvrdnjava se.
Sedmica može donijeti do 31 cm, od toga do 2 cm u naredna tri dana.
Najsnježniji dan: četvrtak, 26. novembra, do 27 cm.
Kasnije, u danima 8–14, na najsnježnijim padinama može pasti još do 13 cm.
Nijedan od ski-centara koje pratimo (12) još nema snijega na stazama.

advice: Prije skijanja van staza pročitajte lokalni lavinski bilten.
